projectDescription: A whole-brain leaky integrate-and-fire simulation of the adult Drosophila brain using the FlyWire connectome (~138k neurons, ~5M synapses), benchmarked across six computational frameworks including Brian2, Brian2CUDA, PyTorch, NEST GPU, GeNN, and Brian2GeNN.
keyFeatures: Whole-brain Drosophila LIF simulation from the FlyWire connectome (~138k neurons, ~5M synapses)
Six interchangeable backends: Brian2 (CPU), Brian2CUDA, PyTorch, NEST GPU, GeNN, and Brian2GeNN
Batched trial parallelism for GPU backends (PyTorch batches n_run trials simultaneously)
Reproducible paper benchmark suite with labeled rounds and spike parquet outputs
Accuracy validation against Brian2 CPU ground truth via Jaccard overlap, firing-rate correlation, and spike-count ratios
Spike timing exports in Parquet format with canonical schema (time_ms, trial, neuron_index, flywire_id)
Incremental CSV result logging with setup/build/simulation timing columns
Configurable experiments: Sugar GRNs (200 Hz) and P9 forward-walking (100 Hz)
WSL2 + CUDA setup automation via setup_WSL_CUDA.sh
publicApiSurface: benchmark.run_benchmarks(backends, t_run_values, n_run_values, experiment, logger, rounds, run_label, round_start)
benchmark.BACKEND_NAMES: {cpu, gpu, pytorch, nestgpu, genn, brian2genn}
run_brian2_cuda.run_all_benchmarks(use_cuda, t_run_values, n_run_values, experiment, logger, run_label, round_idx)
run_genn.run_all_benchmarks(t_run_values, n_run_values, experiment, logger, run_label, round_idx)
Spike parquet schema: time_ms, trial, neuron_index, flywire_id, exp_name
